verdict.rationale: Community reports indicate DeepSeek's V4 Flash weights are available and practical to run locally (~154 GB native precision). Distilled open models such as DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B also exist, and commenters call it open-source. However, no first-party documentation in the pack covers weight downloads, the license terms, or self-hosting instructions. missing for 10: first-party documentation of weight distribution and location, a stated license for the weights, official self-hosting/run guidance, hands-on corroboration of actually running the weights.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can download the model weights under a stated license and run them myself — or the platform is honest that weights are closed

citations.quote: native precision weights total ~154 GB, KV cache 10% as much as V3 - very accessible for people running large local models
the Llama 8B model trained on R1 outputs (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B)
